modalities.evidence: EEG recordings from Parkinson's disease (PD) patients

output.population: Human; Parkinson's disease patients (Hoehn & Yahr stage 3 or below, able to walk independently) and healthy controls; ages 39–84
output.summary: EEG recorded from Parkinson's disease patients and healthy controls during eyes-open sitting rest and treadmill walking, with demographic, medication dose and cognitive screening measures, collected at a medical center in Tel Aviv.
